text: ほんとうに　ゴールデンボール　ブリッジが　すきなんだな　きみは！

structure.jp: ほんとうに　ゴールデンボール　ブリッジが　すきなんだな
structure.en: you really do like Nugget Bridge, huh

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and shows the speaker has worked something out from what he sees. After すき it needs な in front. すきなんだな = 'so you really like it, huh'.

patterns.name: 〜な (remark)
patterns.explanation: The last な shows the speaker is remarking on something he has just noticed, like 'huh'. すきなんだな = 'you like it, huh'.
